  Features  
 Key Features 
 
 
 
 
  
 
Multi-Shop Dashboard
 
Switch between locations and watch revenue, cash collected, gross profit, and due outstanding update in real time.
 
 
  
 
Inventory & POS
 
Barcode scanning, stock alerts, low-stock warnings, and a full POS terminal — all connected to the same ledger.
 
 
  
 
Flexiload & MFS
 
Track flexiload and mobile financial service commissions alongside product sales in one daily summary.
 
 
  
 
Sales Trends
 
Seven-day line charts, overdue case tracking, and backup status — see patterns before they become problems.
 
 
  
 
Customer Ledger
 
Due outstanding, overdue cases, and payment history per shop — know who owes what at a glance.
 
 
  
 
Reports & Alerts
 
Stock transfers, audit logs, user permissions, and configurable alerts for low stock and overdue payments.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Built With 
 
  Next.js  TypeScript  PostgreSQL  Tailwind CSS  Docker  
 
 
 
 FAQ 
 
 
  What types of shops is Invexo built for?     
 Invexo is designed for small retail shops — telecom counters, libraries, convenience stores, and multi-location businesses that need inventory, POS, and commission tracking in one place. 
 
 
  Can I manage multiple shop locations?     
 Yes. Switch between shops from the dashboard sidebar. Revenue, cash collected, profit, and due outstanding update per location. 
 
 
  Does it support flexiload and MFS commissions?     
 Absolutely. Flexiload and mobile financial service commissions are tracked alongside product sales in your daily summary. 
 
 
  Is there a demo available?     
 Contact us for a personalized walkthrough. We tailor onboarding to your shop's workflow.
